captions: Tabelle 28: Sachbilanz Gipsputz und Weissputz, Entsorgung - CH (p.197)
reason: This dataset is 'Gipsputz (Weissputz), Herstellung'. In Kasser 2016 the Gipsputze appear only as a DISPOSAL inventory (Tab. 28). Section E.1.2.4 states that the production data were supplied by the Gesamtverband der Gipsindustrie under confidentiality, so 'in diesem Bericht keine detaillierten Angaben zu den Inhaltsstoffen der Gipsputze [darge]stellt' - no production inventory is printed. Tab. 17-25 are the Sachbilanzen of the other plasters (dispersion, silicate, cement-lime, ...), not of the gypsum plaster.
